description: This file is a PHP source file for a web-based import view component in the SuiteCRM/SugarCRM platform. It defines a class that manages the first step of an import process, including rendering the UI, handling user interactions, and integrating external API sources.

classes.name: ImportViewStep1
classes.description: A class that extends ImportView to handle the first step of the import process including rendering UI components and managing external sources.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the import step 1 view, setting current step and import module based on request parameters.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Generates the page title parameters including icons and links.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the import step 1 UI, including module options, external sources, and Javascript for interactivity.

methods.name: getImportablePersonModulesJS
methods.description: Returns a list of importable person-type modules for JavaScript use.

methods.name: getAllImportableExternalEAPMs
methods.description: Returns a list of all external API modules available for import.

methods.name: getAuthenticatedImportableExternalEAPMs
methods.description: Returns a list of external API modules authenticated and available for import.

methods.name: _getJS
methods.description: Generates and returns JavaScript code to handle user interactions on the import step 1 page.
